name: vyomi
description: Run and test cloud code locally against Vyomi, the AWS/GCP/Azure simulator (Nano in your browser, or a Pro/Max mesh): find your simulator, scan a repo, see what is emulated where, wire SDKs to it, and tell every coding agent about it via AGENTS.md. Needs vyomi-tunnel 1.3.0+ (1.4.0+ for the AGENTS.md step).
